```{r}
fibro <- read.csv("data/marker_list_claude/Fibrosis_Stromal_Markers.csv")
fibro_lst <- fibro %>% with(split(Mouse_Ortholog, Cell_State_or_Program))
mat    <- Seurat::GetAssayData(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
                               assay = "SCT",
                               layer = "data")

scores <- UCell::ScoreSignatures_UCell(mat, features = fibro_lst)
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc <- AddMetaData(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
                                        scores)

pdf("fibro.pdf",height = 5,width = 15)
l <- lapply(colnames(scores),function(gs){
  FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,features = gs,reduction = "umap.nn",split.by = "sample.name",pt.size = 0.1, order = T)&scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo")&RestoreLegend()
})
l
dev.off()
```
